Preferred ICT sessions

  • London 02:00–05:00
  • NY AM 08:30–11:00

Session note: New York ET is the reference timezone. IST must be converted dynamically because the offset changes with US daylight saving time.

ICT models & market context

Models: GC–SI comparison, Liquidity sweep + MSS, FVG / OB

Drivers: Gold relationship, Industrial demand, US real yields, USD / Fed, Geopolitics

News catalysts: CPI, NFP, FOMC, Central-bank demand, Industrial metals demand, Geopolitics

Use the Gold methodology as a starting framework, but independently validate SI liquidity, volatility, stop size and GC–SI relationship.

Related markets: GC, DX, ZN

Comparison discipline: GC–SI comparison only; synchronise contract month and session.
